rules.description: Every dependency check must have an explicit timeoutMs bound
At least one dependency must be declared in healthcheck-spec.json
Liveness checks must not reference remote systems (database, redis, http, queue)
Readiness output must be JSON with status per dependency
Health checks must be read-only — no writes, deletes, or mutations
Failing dependency must return deterministic unhealthy or degraded status, not throw or swallow
